about: Print-checked corrections already made in sources/<dir>/book-NN.html. Each find/replace is whitespace-collapsed text of that work's public primary English (book, column as built). find must be absent from the parsed book and replace present: pipeline/tests/test_english_corrections.py. Ported 2026-09-29 from classical-philosophy-reader sources/aristotle-english/corrections.json (commit 85c876b); source names the scan each was checked against. Four Lin entries were retired 2026-09-29: they had corrected Joachim's commentary, which the OCR had run into his translation and which was then removed (pipeline/tests/test_lin_joachim_clean.py).

corrections.find: Those that depend upon the assumption of the original point and upon stating as the cause what is not the cause, are clearly shown to be cases of ignoratio elenchi through the definition thereof.
